title: Cutoff for q-deformed classical card shuffles in the type A Iwahori--Hecke algebra
summary: We study the mixing behavior of three q-deformed card shuffles on $\mathcal{H}_q(S_n)$: the short systematic scan introduced in \cite{DiaconisRam2000}, the $q$--deformed random--to--random shuffle introduced in \cite{AxelrodFreedBraunerChiangComminsLang2024}, and the $q$--deformed $k$--star transposition shuffle, whose $q=1$ counterpart was studied in \cite{ArfaeeNestoridi}. The first two chains were diagonalized in \cite{DiaconisRam2000} and \cite{AxelrodFreedBraunerChiangComminsLang2024}, respectively.
